launchers.description: launcher commands can only be defined in machine config (~/.config/chernabog/config.yaml)

runners.description: runners is the team's choice, in .chernabog/config.yaml; to run a flow here anyway, set flows.<flow>.enabled: true

agent.description: The adapter this flow's agent steps run with, over the repo's agent.

agents.description: Adapters by role, such as { reviewer: codex }: a step given { role } runs with that role's adapter, falling back to this flow's agent and then the repo's.

anyOf.description: Start only work items whose assignees include one of these: @me for this machine's GitHub login, a login, or none for nobody. null clears the team's.
Start only work items whose requested reviewers include one of these: @me for this machine's GitHub login, a login, or none for nobody. null clears the team's.

runners.description: runners is the team's choice, in .chernabog/config.yaml; to run a flow here anyway, set flows.<flow>.enabled: true
